payload.entry: LAND AUDIT / FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (HEAD and fetched origin/master 055f9b6e): read this epic and every note on ls.2.1.1/.2/.3, parent phase ls.2 and outer epic ls, both linked plans, design match/import/attribution sections, and production code plus epic commits c59b5b80, 96b35f41, 055f9b6e. Decisions remain payee_source=record_title and no memory edits; outer Markdown naming is still ls.4 scope. Interleaved gcal commits ee6d6503/476c5440/d794e0ba/b638fb0d need no subscription integration; bank-config 248befdd already shares the merged CLI and config APIs, so preserve config fingerprints and located diagnostics in repairs. Old clippy note: RecordField import removed in 96b35f41; cadence/pricing/status methods now have callers, though unused re-export allowances remain for later consumers. epic-symbols currently empty and no symvision recipe. Remaining epic defects: affected_rows enriches only wanted rows against input.journal rather than the full projected journal+row after-state, drops new before_start history, and ignores current links on unaffected rows; source-free -F skips the registry entirely. Orphan ID rows enter record ledger totals; journal-only inference cannot consult config rules. Money code saturates/uses unchecked refund sum; four-weekly large representable monthly results can become zero. current_step never goes negative for future renews and caps old schedules at 240. Registry dependency guards cover album declarations but omit consulted parent/non-album bytes. Required CLI subscription parity and guarded-apply tests are missing. These stay epic work in a medium tale that must finish this epic and parent phase closeout.
